text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On one of my days off, I spot Symboli
Kris S and
Hishi Amazon talking in front
of the academy
gates.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to make you do all that, but
everyone in the
dorm will really
appreciate it! I'm counting on you!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Understood.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Later, while walking around town and
thinking
about how serious their
exchange sounded...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I suddenly sense an overwhelming aura
behind
me. Shocked, I turn around to
see Symboli Kris S.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: I have... a task.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...This.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She holds out her phone and shows me
an image
on the screen.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Have you... seen this before?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
I mean this one. This brand's tail
shampoo.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...I see. Thank you for your cooperation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And with that, Symboli Kris S sprints off
with
purpose. What the heck was that all
about?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Dang, we really owe you one! You
seriously saved
our bacon!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Someone made a mistake with the
dorm's tail
shampoo order, and we were
just about to run out
of the stuff.
choice_data_list: What on earth did they want?
What on earth did they want?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
So I asked Kris S if she could go grab us
some more. There were a bunch of
different brands we
needed, but she
went and found every last one!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
To be precise... there was one shampoo I
couldn't
find.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah, you mean the one that reduces
tail frizz when it's humid out? But you
found us one with
pretty much the same
ingredients, so it's all good!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, we can keep tackling our
races
fearlessly and with nice soft tails,
even when it's
cloudy out.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A small mountain of shopping bags lies at
Symboli Kris S's feet. I can't even
hazard a guess
at how many stores she
must have stopped by.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A small mountain of shopping bags lies at
Symboli Kris S's feet. I can't even
hazard a guess
at how many stores she
must have stopped by.

Is there really shampoo just for c...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
I anticipated both the weight and
distance... It
was no trouble.
choice_data_list: There's even shampoo for cloudy days?
Is there really shampoo just for c...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
When given a task... see it through. That
is my
creed.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, 'cause it's not like it gets bad
enough where we have to use rainy day
styling products, so during the humid
months, we fight the frizz with a good
shampoo.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Anything we can do to stay in top form,
we do. It
only makes sense.
